title: He Will Surely Do It
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: Spirit, soul and body: God's promise to finish his work in us is complete. He who calls you is faithful.
exhortation: I don't know if there's a more comforting promise from the Lord, or a more complete one, than this: he will finish the work he started in us.

Look at how complete it is: "your whole spirit and soul and body." We will be kept blameless. What a holistic, complete promise. And it rests on him, not on us: "He who calls you is faithful; he will surely do it." What great grace we have in Christ Jesus, and what a wonderful hope.
prayer: Lord, thank you for finding us in the depths of our sin and bringing our hearts from total deadness to life. Thank you for the promise of restored bodies and a time without sickness, creaky backs and everything else we deal with on this earth. One day those things will pass away, and we will be raised with you to new life, with new bodies, to live with you forever. What a hope we are called to. Thank you, Jesus.
For all you've done for us, may we fix our eyes on you this morning. Fill our gaze, and fill our hearts with fresh hope and renewed strength for your mission here on earth. In Jesus' name, amen.
